notes.title: TwoKinds Online - New Combat
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, big changes to combat! Other changes include NPC factions, animation system overhaul, and more! Due to time constraints, this is part one of the combat series updates.

[h1]Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] New Animation System
[*]Combat
[list]
   [*]Melee attacks
   [*]Stat updates 
   [*]Ranged bows still WIP
[/list]
[*]Left-handed characters
[*]Sprint
[*]Factions
[*]Dances
[*]Guild Chat with Vivox
[*]Improved town buildings
[*]Playtest changes and Steam achievements
[*]End of Discord game updates
[*]Physiology Skill
[/list]

[h1]Combat[/h1]

Melee combat has been completely redone! Tons of adjustments have been made so the experience should be a lot smoother. Due to the time constraints, this will be part one of the combat updates, soon to be followed by Bows/Ranged weapons, blocking, and improved AI combat tactics.

[previewyoutube=DBgkcHcL7WI;full][/previewyoutube]

NPCs will now show relative power levels in their name tags. Normally the information is hidden but can be viewed by holding ALT. Name tags for NPCs will also show basic health information that will increase in detail with the skill Physiology.

Foxes and rabbits are now easier to hunt and no longer will attack on sight. Beware of butterflies though, they are violent.

[h1]Sprint[/h1]

Movement has been changed and there is now a sprint button! Sprinting uses stamina and can be used to break from combat or faster world traversal.

[h1]Factions[/h1]

Npcs are now split into more factions than just violent and nonviolent. Foxes will no longer attack immediately. Town people now react and attack back if they are hit. They will no longer just stand idly and embrace death but will fight back.
[img]https://cookiedragon.sfo2.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/blog/v0_54_0/TwokindsOnline20210722T23_28_32_136544807_00.png[/img]

[h1]Dances[/h1]

New dances! Up to 4 available dances now.

[previewyoutube=1cE12uygVME;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Guild Chat[/h1]

Guild chat is now available using Vivox. We are liking Vivox so far and will use it for party chat and friend whispers in the future.

[h1]Playtest Changes[/h1]

We are switching to the Steam playtest feature for testing access instead of grabbing a Steam Key from the website. Make sure to request access on the Steam Store page and don't forget to wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/690100/TwoKinds_Online/

[img]https://cookiedragon.sfo2.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/blog/v0_54_0/PlaytestAccess.PNG[/img]

We are also adding some Steam achievements unique to the playtest game, so make sure to get them if you are an achievement hunter. We don't plan on revoking access to the unreleased game if you used a Steam key but we recommend switching to the playtest on Steam.

[h1]End of Discord Game Updates[/h1]

We are ending support of playing the game through Discord. With the end of the Discord Store years ago and other things, we are focusing on Steam as our main platform to play. The Discord version will not be getting any more updates so make sure to switch to the Steam playtest.

[h1]Up Next[/h1]

We are really excited for what's coming next. We are very busy working on bows, new content, new enemies to fight, and of course always more! Thank you for being on this adventure with us.

Original blog post on [url=https://www.twokinds.online/blog/details/tk-0-54-0-combat]twokinds.online[/url]

notes.title: TwoKinds Online Alpha - Currency Update
notes.notes:
It's update time! This one is full of internal changes along with money and a new outfit!

Curious on how to try the alpha? Head over to https://www.twokinds.online/game/download to get signed up!

[h1]Money/Currency[/h1]

Currency is here! Right now, you can make some money from quests and soon you will be able to buy and sell items from shops. To start, there is only one currency available, the human kingdom currency. In the future, there will be multiple currencies! We will add money for the Keidran kingdoms and Basitin kingdoms, with exchange rates and region dependent values.

[img]https://cookiedragon.sfo2.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/blog/v0_53_0/TwokindsOnline20210209T19_40_36_346412708_00_Money.png[/img]

[h1]Maid Outfit[/h1]

Always wanted a maid outfit like [url=https://www.deviantart.com/twokinds/art/Maid-Outfit-Kathrin-847578632]this[/url]? Now you can make one! Go talk to the Tailor in town and they will teach you how to make a maid outfit if you do a quest for them. Happy weaving!

[img]https://wiki.twokinds.online/items/maid-outfit/keidranmaidmale.png[/img]

There is a new gathering resource for making Thread and Cloth. Get the crafting recipes from the Tailor and harvest flax to start making thread.

[img]https://cookiedragon.sfo2.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/blog/v0_53_0/TwokindsOnline20210209T19_36_45_722129108_00.png[/img]

[h1]Quest Start Panel[/h1]

Curious about quest details and rewards? The quest start panel is here! You can accept or reject quests before they go to your quest journal. Your quest journal now contains more details about the quest and their rewards.

[img]https://cookiedragon.sfo2.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com/blog/v0_53_0/TwokindsOnline20210209T19_37_10_489878708_00.png[/img]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Continuing to rework character animations. Our goal is to improve performance to increase the amount of characters on screen.
[*] Low graphic setting now disables Keidran ear floppiness.
[*] Internal changes have been made to create instanced areas for dungeons. There is still a lot of work to be done.
[*] Added fix for players spawning way out of the play area. Someone had an issue with their character spawning very far away and very wrong.
[*] Keidran and Basitin Foot Wraps are back!
[/list]

Original blog post here - https://www.twokinds.online/blog/details/tk-update-0-53-2-money
